product_metadata.title: Dirt Devil Endura Reach Bagless Upright Vacuum Cleaner, UD20124V, Red
features: NO LOSS OF SUCTION: Consistently powerful performance on carpets and hard floors
HASSLE-FREE MAINTENANCE: Easily access the rinsable filter for quick maintenance that will help extend the life of your vacuum
EASY-EMPTY DIRT CUP: Take fewer, quicker, and easier trips to the trash with the one touch easy-release dirt cup
LIGHT WITH A BITE: This compact upright packs some serious multi-floor cleaning power in a conveniently lightweight design for an effortless clean

QUICK & EASY REACH: Clean higher surfaces with the flexability and ease of the quick release, on-board extension wand for 10 feet of total reach. Plus, 20 feet of cord length to clean from room to room without having to unplug.
CONVENIENT ON-BOARD STORAGE: Easily maneuver corners and tight spaces using the 2-in-1 dusting brush and crevice tool with convenient on-board storage for tackling messes at a minute’s notice
WHAT'S INCLUDED: A 2-in-1 dusting brush and crevice tool stores on-board for messes at a minute’s notice
description: The Endura Reach is packed with powerful suction to tackle dirt anywhere in your home with the power of the improved Endura filtration system. A compact design with a quick-release wand gives you 10ft of extra cleaning reach making it easy to clean any mess, while the multi-floor brush roll cuts through dirt on carpet and hard floors. Enjoy the convenience of the easy-empty dirt cup which gets rid of the dirt with one touch of a button and reach any corner with the 2-in-1 dusting brush and crevice tool.

details.Included Components: extension wand, Dusting Brush, Crevice Tool
